title: Application to Hire a Community Hall

headings.text: Application to Hire a Community Hall

key_sentences: Please complete all sections in block capitals and return the form at least 21 days before the date of your event.
Bookings are not confirmed until you receive a written confirmation from the bookings clerk.
If alcohol is to be sold, you must obtain a temporary event notice from the district council and attach a copy to this form.
A refundable damage deposit of £75.00 is payable for every booking.
I have read the conditions of hire and agree to keep to them.
I understand that the deposit may be kept in part or in full to cover any damage or extra cleaning.

list_items.text: The hirer must be aged 18 or over and must be present throughout the booking.
leaving the hall clean and tidy, with all rubbish removed;
switching off lights and heating and locking all doors.
No more than the stated number of people may be in a room at any time.
Decorations must not be fixed to walls or ceilings with nails, tape or adhesive putty.
Bookings cancelled less than 7 days before the event will be charged in full.

notes: A two-page application form. Running header (council name left, form number right) and the centred footer "Form HB1 · Page n of N" are furniture. Section titles "Section A – About you" etc. are level-2 headings; field labels (Full name, Postcode, ...) and the empty answer boxes are form fields, not headings and not tables. Check-box options ("Main hall (up to 120 people)", "Yes", "No") are drawn boxes next to labels, not list items. The hire-charges table has rules between rows only. The conditions list (Section D) is a CSS-drawn decimal list with a nested CSS-drawn lower-roman level (markers not in the text). The "For office use only" table has a full grid; its second row is empty (four empty strings). Page 2 starts with a forced page break.
